stem: At a certain shop, customers arrive independently and randomly at a constant average rate of 23.4 per hour.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that, in a randomly chosen 1-minute period, at least 2 customers arrive.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: The random variable $X$ denotes the number of customers who arrive in a randomly chosen 1-hour period.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: State a suitable approximating distribution for $X$, giving the value(s) of any parameter(s).

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Use your approximating distribution to find $\text{P}(20 < X < 30)$.
